analysis:
MARKET REGIME: SPY uptrend is constructive (+1.07% 20d slope) though not euphoric. Breadth supports holding quality longs. No reason to panic-cash, but no reason to over-deploy either.

PORTFOLIO REVIEW — EXISTING POSITIONS:
• NVDA (+7.0%): Thesis intact. Fundamentals are exceptional (ROE 117%, revenue +106%, fwd PEG 0.48, massive EPS revision +22%). Still in candidate list. Hold.
• IT (+4.48%): Thesis intact. EPS revision +6.9%, SMA50 slope +12.3%, fwd P/E 11.79 is attractive. In candidate list. Hold.
• FOXA (-3.79%): NOT in current screened candidate list — meaning it likely failed a quality or trend filter this cycle. Loss is modest. Recommend watching closely; if the fundamental thesis cannot be clearly restated and confirmed, this position should be reduced or closed on the next bounce.
• AMP (-9.56%): STRONG THESIS-BREAK SIGNAL. AMP is NOT in the screened candidate list. This is the third attempt at this name in this account — both prior trades were stopped out (-3.12%, -3.81%). The position is now -9.56% and approaching the original drawdown ceiling. Recommend closing AMP promptly to stop the bleeding. Repeating a name that has failed twice while the stock is now excluded from quality+trend screens is exactly the kind of behavior this strategy must avoid.

HISTORICAL PERFORMANCE ALERT: 0% win rate over 10 losses with avg -4.78% is a hard data signal that we must be extremely selective and not force entries. The mandate here is capital preservation, not manufacturing alpha. Closing AMP and holding FOXA cautiously while deploying only one well-structured new trade is the disciplined response.

NEW TRADE RATIONALE: ULTA Beauty screens as the single high-conviction setup this cycle. It sits in the lower third of its 52-week range (34%), is in a confirmed uptrend with a basing structure, carries one of the highest ROEs in the candidate universe (46.1%), has no earnings until December 3 (62 days — full buffer), and has reasonable forward valuation (fwd P/E 16.76) with solid FCF. Position sizing keeps portfolio heat at ~1% even on a full stop-hit. R/R clears 3x. Only one new trade is proposed consistent with the capital-preservation mandate and the sobering win-rate history.

The setup matches the Weinstein Stage 1-to-2 transition the strategy targets.
trades.exit_plan: Primary exit: target $610 (represents midpoint recovery toward 52-week high). Stop: $513 (1.5x ATR below entry). Thesis-break exits: (1) if ULTA reports any significant consumer spending deterioration before December earnings, reassess. (2) If price closes below SMA50 on elevated volume, tighten or exit.
